definitions.explanation: The state of not falling under a given category, condition, or rule. Common on forms, checklists, and official documents to mark an item that does not apply.

examples.japanese: {該当|がいとう}しない{項目|こうもく}は{非該当|ひがいとう}と{記入|きにゅう}する。
examples.english: For items that do not apply, write "not applicable."

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}のケースは{規定|きてい}に{非該当|ひがいとう}だ。
examples.english: This case does not fall under the regulations.

examples.japanese: {審査|しんさ}の{結果|けっか}、{申請|しんせい}は{補助金|ほじょきん}の{対象|たいしょう}に{非該当|ひがいとう}と{判断|はんだん}された。
examples.english: As a result of the review, the application was judged not eligible for the subsidy.

notes:
Formed from the negative prefix {非|ひ} + {該当|がいとう} (falling under; applying). Appears mainly on forms and in administrative or legal writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非該当|ひがいとう}とする: to treat as not applicable
- {非該当|ひがいとう}と{判断|はんだん}する: to judge as not applicable
- {対象|たいしょう}に{非該当|ひがいとう}: not covered (by the criteria)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {該当|がいとう}: applying; falling under — the affirmative counterpart.
- {対象外|たいしょうがい}: outside the scope; excluded — close in meaning, more common in everyday use.
